import Mathlib

theorem solo_esas (a r₁ r₂ x : ℤ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a * (x - r₁) * (x - r₂) = 0 ↔ x = r₁ ∨ x = r₂ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h3 | h4
      · exact absurd h3 ha
      · left
        linarith
    · right
      linarith
  · rintro (h | h) <;> subst h <;> ring
